_comment: Job 2d31a58dc893d052 measured 35/40 ALL.js grids on the manifold engine with a 320s hang guard per grid, the pool at concurrency 4 and the five aggregates one at a time afterwards. No grid crashed the renderer. A cell whose model throws draws a skull-and-crossbones and the grid scores partial; after a wasm trap every later cell fails as not run. render-all.mjs --baseline diffs a run against failures[], cells included.
